wallpapers.title: SATURN
wallpapers.line1: 126 pictures joined into one natural-colour view of Saturn and its rings, from 6.3 million km away.

wallpapers.title: JUPITER'S GREAT RED SPOT
wallpapers.line1: The Great Red Spot (left) and the cloud bands of Jupiter's south, from 16,535 km above the clouds.
wallpapers.line2: Juno, colours enhanced  ·  10 July 2017  ·  NASA/JPL-Caltech/SwRI/MSSS, Gerald Eichstädt, Seán Doran (CC BY-NC-SA)

wallpapers.title: PLUTO'S BLUE HAZE
wallpapers.line1: The Sun, behind Pluto, lights up layers of blue haze over 200 km high. Close to true colour.
wallpapers.line2: New Horizons, 200,000 km from Pluto  ·  14 July 2015  ·  NASA/Johns Hopkins APL/Southwest Research Institute

wallpapers.title: IO, NORTH POLE
wallpapers.line1: Jupiter's volcanic moon Io. Low sunlight at the edge of night shows mountains up to 9.8 km high.
wallpapers.line2: Juno, 57th close pass  ·  30 December 2023  ·  NASA/JPL-Caltech/SwRI/MSSS, image processing: Gerald Eichstädt

wallpapers.title: A FAREWELL TO SATURN
wallpapers.line1: Cassini's last full picture of Saturn and its rings, taken two days before it plunged into the planet.
wallpapers.line2: Cassini, 1.1 million km from Saturn  ·  13 September 2017  ·  NASA/JPL-Caltech/Space Science Institute

wallpapers.title: EUROPA
wallpapers.line1: Jupiter's icy moon from 1,521 km up. Bright and dark ridges and bands cross its cracked ice.
wallpapers.line2: Juno, colours enhanced  ·  29 September 2022  ·  NASA/JPL-Caltech/SwRI/MSSS, Björn Jónsson (CC BY-NC-SA)

wallpapers.title: JUPITER'S SOUTH
wallpapers.line1: One white oval here belongs to the String of Pearls: eight giant spinning storms at 40 degrees south.
wallpapers.line2: Juno, colours enhanced  ·  24 October 2017  ·  NASA/JPL-Caltech/SwRI/MSSS, Gerald Eichstädt, Seán Doran (CC BY-NC-SA)

wallpapers.title: NEAR SUNSET ON PLUTO
wallpapers.line1: Icy mountains up to 3,500 m high, flat ice plains, and more than a dozen layers of haze, lit from behind.
wallpapers.line2: New Horizons, 18,000 km from Pluto  ·  14 July 2015  ·  NASA/Johns Hopkins APL/Southwest Research Institute
